# CG-RES-001: Required response property removed

A required property was removed from a response schema.

**Why it matters:** A guaranteed field is no longer guaranteed.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.propertyRemoved` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Required property "{property}" was removed from {where}.
>
> Consumers rely on "{property}" always being present; it may now be missing.
>
> **Fix:** Keep returning "{property}" (deprecate it first), or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: required email removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id, email], properties: {id: {}, email: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id], properties: {id: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Required property "email" was removed from GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Does not fire: request direction

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id, email], properties: {id: {}, email: {}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id], properties: {id: {}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: property moved into an allOf parent

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id, email], properties: {id: {}, email: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {allOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Base'}, {type: object, required: [email], properties: {email: {}}}]}}}}}
+ components:
+   schemas:
+     Base: {type: object, required: [id], properties: {id: {}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
